(Jordan’s Year 14 includes his baseball year: 13 seasons played · LeBron’s fourth title came in Year 17)
Sources: NBA.com, ESPN, Associated Press, Britannica, Wikipedia; key dates cross-checked across at least two outlets. Original design, no logos or artwork.
Conventions: calendar axis uses season-start years (1984 = the 1984–85 season); offseason events sit at the start of the following season. MVP = regular-season MVP. All-Star counts through 2025–26.
*LeBron’s 24th season (2026–27, with the 76ers) is in progress, so no season stats are printed. Jordan’s 1994–95 season was 17 games. Made Nov 19, 2026.
